name: SDR / Radio
description: Hardware-gated 433.92 MHz sensor snapshots plus installed SDR, AIS, and radio-control utilities.
help_text: The enabled profile requires exactly one reviewed 0bda:2832/2838 dongle with a safe USB serial and no claimed kernel driver. It receives for 20 seconds at fixed 433.92 MHz, emits bounded JSON text, and never starts rtl_tcp or saves raw I/Q.
